title: RRB Group D 27 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - Mathematics - Compound Interest
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: The amount on a sum of ₹6,800 at 15% per annum compound interest, compounded annually, in 2 years' time, will be:
questions.explain:
The formula for compound amount is $A = P(1 + r/100)^n$. 
$A = 6800 \times (1 + 15/100)^2$ 
$= 6800 \times (1.15)^2$ 
$= 6800 \times 1.3225 = 8993$. 
Thus, the total amount is ₹8,993.
